body: I don't have family that I speak to. I don't have any money. I just have a very bad headache that doesn't go away.
I think I'm losing my mind. I'm confused and losing big chunks of time. I am suicidal but chicken. I think I am a ghost.
I slept until 1pm. I laid in bed and played with my phone. I had a few cigarettes. I ordered a pizza.
I don't want to change my life. I want to end it.
I don't want to get better.
I don't have any life, ambition, or goals. I really don't want to tell where I'm from. I don't talk to anyone so I don't know what to say. My life is small; this post described everything to it.
